questions.question: Six family members Viraaj, Deepu, Noor, Prince, Suman and Taran are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Viraaj is sitting to the immediate right of Noor. Prince is an immediate neighbour of both Viraaj and Deepu. Suman is sitting third to the right of Viraaj. Noor is sitting second to the left of Prince. Who is the immediate neighbour of Deepu and Viraaj?
questions.solution:
**Given : **Six family members Viraaj, Deepu, Noor, Prince, Suman and Taran are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

**Explanation : **

1) Viraaj is sitting to the immediate right of Noor.

2) Prince is an immediate neighbour of both Viraaj and Deepu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b6a56b6756be06a2f94c275761f800cdd9b957d9fb6a288252081a820d6b1b0.png] 

3) Suman is sitting third to the right of Viraaj.

4) Noor is sitting second to the left of Prince.

After positioning Suman only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e Taran.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dca607e507ad9e2fbb7c3bac93cca37c4c2c79949fcdc41995bf3ec822504a2.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement Prince is an immediate neighbour of Deepu and Viraaj.

Hence, **"Prince"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mobiles are computers.

Some computers are furniture.

Some furniture are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tables are computers.

II. Some mobiles are furniture.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db787344c399d2e90b6ba2828d565d3b420cafae24d315cd649303a7dcb63a0d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tables are computers → Does not Follow (As, some computers are furniture and some furniture are tables. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

II. Some mobiles are furniture → Does not Follow (As, all mobiles are computers and some computers are furniture. So, it is possible but not definitely true.)

So, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion I nor II follows"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third word in the same way as the second word is related to the first word.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)

Education : Teacher :: Treatment : ?
questions.solution:
**Logic :** Action or service : Provider of of action or service

So,

__
 
• **Education** is provided by a **teacher**.

Similarly,

 
• **Treatment **is provided by a **doctor**.

Hence, **"Doctor"** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hospital → Place where treatment is done
 
• Labour → workers of a non-skilled task.
 
• Medicine → Given to a patients for treatment
 
• Doctor → Provides treatment to patients
